title: Eight-fifty
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. The arithmetic. Eight-fifty an hour, three days, on the back of a mat offcut. Behind the sums, on the corkboard at home: the letter that would have paid for everything. The strip puts them in the same panel.

panels.composition: The bedroom. WOOD at the desk doing sums on a mat offcut. BARNABY. The corkboard: the three letters.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man at a desk writing sums on a scrap of mat board, a small dog, a corkboard with three pinned letters behind

panels.composition: The sums: 8.50 × 8 × 3 = 204. Minus the Datsun's gas. Minus the digest's copies. = 61.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of hand-written arithmetic on a scrap of mat board ending in a small number

panels.composition: Wood looking from the 61 to the corkboard. The acceptance letter. The number in it, not drawn. The strip's eyes go there; Wood's don't.

characters.pose: looking at the sums, not the board

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man looking down at a scrap of arithmetic while a corkboard with letters hangs behind him unregarded, no words

panels.composition: The offcut pinned to the corkboard, over the acceptance letter. Covering it. 61.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man pinning a scrap of mat board with arithmetic on it over a letter on a corkboard, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 61 dollars, pinned over the letter that would have paid for everything.
